nodes.rationale: Skip Cloudflare build/deploy commands if no relevant frontend code files or configuration changes exist between HEAD^ and HEAD, saving build minutes.

nodes.label: Transient Flow Modeling
nodes.author: Chris Tran
nodes.rationale: Steady-state simulations are useless for 2026 aero; transient aerodynamic modeling of transitions requires Detached/Large Eddy Simulations (DES/LES) optimized to fit restricted supercomputing budgets.

nodes.label: Active Aero Fail-Safes
nodes.author: Chris Tran
nodes.rationale: To mitigate safety risks at 200 mph, systems require spring-loaded high-downforce defaults, Triple Modular Redundancy (TMR) for sensors, and deterministic RTOS control loops.

nodes.label: ZFS Hardware Stability Decisions
nodes.author: Chris Tran
nodes.rationale: ZFS offloads intelligence to CPU/RAM, requiring AES-NI, ECC RAM (highly recommended for ARC caching), and LSI HBAs in IT mode instead of cheap SATA multipliers or hardware RAID.

nodes.author: Chris Tran
nodes.norm_label: beyond the prompt: clean code in the age of ai

nodes.label: AI-Friendly Clean Architectures
nodes.author: Chris Tran
nodes.rationale: To combat architectural drift and pattern duplication from localized LLM optimization, software must establish hard boundaries with Hexagonal Architecture and use strict typing/DTOs to constrain AI output.

nodes.label: TDD as an AI Anchor
nodes.author: Chris Tran
nodes.rationale: Writing tests first provides automated boundary validation for AI assistants, ensuring implementations are structurally sound before code review.

nodes.label: GPU VRAM Requirements for Local LLMs
nodes.author: Chris Tran
nodes.rationale: To achieve acceptable token speeds, LLMs must fit entirely in VRAM. NVIDIA RTX 3090 (24GB) is the sweet spot; unified memory Apple Silicon offers high capacity but slower speeds.

nodes.label: The Monaco Boredom Factor
nodes.author: Chris Tran
nodes.rationale: Modern larger/heavier F1 cars cannot duel side-by-side in narrow historic streets, making the race a predictable procession.

nodes.author: Chris Tran
nodes.norm_label: nasdaq low-float rules and spacex ipo

nodes.label: NASDAQ Low-Float Loophole
nodes.author: Chris Tran
nodes.rationale: Floating a tiny fraction of equity allows mega-cap private entries to fast-track index inclusion, forcing passive ETF buying and creating explosive price actions while preserving operational control.

nodes.label: Index Systemic Risk
nodes.author: Chris Tran
nodes.rationale: A high-beta, low-float, hyper-hyped stock embedded in the NASDAQ-100 leverages passive index funds to real-world rocket telemetry, making the index vulnerable to physical/engineering failures.

nodes.label: Declarative Operating System State
nodes.author: Chris Tran
nodes.rationale: Mutable OS canvases (Debian/Ubuntu) lead to configuration drift and 'snowflake' servers. NixOS uses declarative config, flakes, and isolated builds in /nix/store to achieve 100% reproducibility and instant rollbacks.

nodes.label: Reimagining Home Media: Plex vs Jellyfin
nodes.author: Chris Tran
nodes.norm_label: reimagining home media: plex vs jellyfin

nodes.label: Plex v2 Automation Architecture
nodes.author: Chris Tran
nodes.rationale: While Jellyfin offers pure open-source freedom, existing Plex Pass lifetime investment makes switching a non-starter. Instead, deploy 'Plex v2' with Servarr (Overseerr/Requestrr) automation.

nodes.label: SpaceX Enterprise Software and Public Debut
nodes.author: Chris Tran
nodes.norm_label: spacex enterprise software and public debut

nodes.label: Compliance-as-Code for SOX 404
nodes.author: Chris Tran
nodes.rationale: To maintain dev speed under SOX 404, SpaceX automates Segregation of Duties (SoD) via cryptographically signed IaC peer approvals and deterministic build pipelines (immutable SBOMs).

nodes.label: WarpDrive ERP GAAP Compliance
nodes.author: Chris Tran
nodes.rationale: WarpDrive must dynamically calculate booster depreciation based on telemetry-proven wear, and correctly categorize WIP steel rings as R&D vs CapEx using block hashing ledgers.

nodes.label: ITAR Security vs. SEC Transparency
nodes.author: Chris Tran
nodes.rationale: SpaceX implements zero-trust data separation and automated sanitization to report financial realities to the SEC/auditors without leaking ITAR-regulated engineering telemetry.

nodes.label: Trading the SpaceX IPO Blog Post
nodes.author: Chris Tran
nodes.norm_label: trading the spacex ipo blog post

nodes.label: SSE LLM Streaming
nodes.rationale: Instead of waiting for full LLM completions, the edge Worker streams individual tokens to the client as they are generated, improving perceived response times.

nodes.label: Durable SQL Storage Pattern
nodes.rationale: Instead of holding chat history entirely in RAM or making slow external database roundtrips, the chat room's Durable Object writes directly to its own local, high-speed SQLite database file using Cloudflare's SQL Storage API.

nodes.label: Scribunto Lua Scripting
nodes.rationale: In MediaWiki, complex calculators (such as championship point standings or constructor grids) are built in Lua to parse input strings dynamically and render structured wikitext.

nodes.label: rclone Cloud Storage Mount
nodes.rationale: Mounting cloud storage drives directly to the filesystem integrates Google Drive and Microsoft 365 Business storage, providing highly resilient off-site storage for backups and media.

nodes.label: 10G/20G Bonded Network Backbone
nodes.rationale: The two hosts are interconnected via a high-speed 10 Gbps bonded connection, configured for link aggregation to achieve up to 20 Gbps of aggregate throughput.

nodes.label: Cloudflare R2 and D1 Edge Storage
nodes.rationale: Generated images and user-uploaded templates are stored inside Cloudflare R2 Object Storage, with their prompts, creation seeds, and dimensions cataloged in a D1 SQL Database to allow instant gallery loading and search filtering.
nodes.norm_label: cloudflare r2 and d1 edge storage

nodes.label: Multi-Broker Hedging Strategy
nodes.rationale: The backend worker uses modular adapters to talk to both Alpaca API (equities/options) and Tradovate API (futures), allowing a single agentic strategy to hedge across asset classes.

nodes.label: Shared-Domain Auto-Login
nodes.rationale: By leveraging parent domain session cookies, sYnID shares one-time authorization tokens across subdomains, instantly logging in users as they navigate between applications without redirect delays.

nodes.label: Simulation Failover Engine
nodes.rationale: If API tokens for Pingdom or StatusGator are not configured, the Cloudflare Worker seamlessly falls back to generating simulated outages so the visualizer remains functional for testing and demonstrations.

nodes.label: Dev Proxy DB Binding
nodes.rationale: The developer setup utilizes Cloudflare's Dev Proxy to dynamically bridge bindings (such as the synx-db D1 database) directly into the local Remix Vite server during development.
